history_summary: Record five native species-reference GTDB correspondences for the Fucoidan degrader panel descriptors.
history_details: Exact encoded NCBI-ID routes reproduce Algibacter lectus AS40, Mariniflexile sp. AS56, Zobellia laminariae AS94, Roseibacillus persicicus AS69 and Lentimonas sp. CC4 reference populations of 19, 2, 5, 4 and 4 genomes, respectively, each with fraction 1.0. These populations do not newly classify the stored study assemblies. Preserve all seven stocks, aliases and GCA identifiers, the AS12 and AS25 null/UNRESOLVED results, excluded G88, source-column distinctions and V4/reference-3 extraction caveat. Numeric GTDB placeholders and the supplement's Roseibacillus_A alias do not establish formal renaming or source-release chronology. Only five GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed; all biological claims and exact source quotations remain intact. The 127 combinations, five-member 97.1% subset and richness/inoculum confound stay distinct from one fixed mutualistic community. Issues 1465 and 1996 retain mechanism and supplement-routing boundaries. The pinned crosswalk's upstream release is unestablished; this is a partial technical correction, not a fresh full-paper or genome audit, scientific approval or corpus QC completion.
